target.title: feat(ios): add OpenClawMascot iconography system with size scale
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS app uses a raw `Image("OpenClawIcon")` call scattered across multiple views (`CommandCenterTab`, `RootTabs`, `OnboardingWizardSteps`) with ad-hoc sizing and shadow parameters. There is no consistent mascot asset catalog entry, no predefined scale system, and no reusable component.

## Why This Change Was Made

The branded styling guide specifies a 6-tier mascot size scale (hero 96pt → inline 20pt) with a minimum rendered size of 20pt. This PR implements the mascot iconography system as a standalone component, decoupled from the broader design-system PR (#99161).

Supersedes #99188 which was stacked on the design-system branch and pulled in unrelated changes.

## User Impact

- **Visual**: Mascot renders from a proper 3-scale asset catalog entry (1x/2x/3x) instead of a single image, improving rendering quality across device densities.
- **Consistency**: All mascot usages now go through `OpenClawMascot` with standardized scale tiers.
- **No behavioral changes**: This PR modifies only mascot rendering; no config, settings, or runtime behavior is affected.

## Changes

### New files
- `apps/ios/Sources/Design/OpenClawMascot.swift` — `OpenClawMascotScale` enum (6 tiers: hero/emptyState/sheet/section/nav/inline), `OpenClawMascot` view with shadow modifier
- `apps/ios/Sources/Assets.xcassets/OpenClawMascot.imageset/` — 1x (171px), 2x (341px), 3x (512px) PNGs

### Modified files
- `OpenClawProComponents.swift` — Deleted `OpenClawProMark` (all usages migrated, zero remaining callers)
- `CommandCenterTab.swift` — `OpenClawProMark(size: 28)` → `OpenClawMascot(scale: .nav)`
- `OnboardingWizardSteps.swift` — `OpenClawProMark(size: 64)` → `OpenClawMascot(scale: .emptyState)`
- `RootTabs.swift` — `OpenClawProMark(size: 30)` → `OpenClawMascot(scale: .section)`
- `RootTabsSourceGuardTests.swift` — Updated assertion to match new usage
- `apps/.i18n/native-source.json` — Synced native i18n inventory

### Asset provenance
Source: OpenClaw CDN mascot PNG (512×512), scaled via `sips` to 1x/2x/3x.

## Visual Proof

### Mascot asset (3x / 512×512)

![OpenClaw Mascot Asset](https://litter.catbox.moe/ohlpz7.png)

### Before (upstream/main) — Onboarding screen using `OpenClawProMark(size: 64)`

![Before - upstream/main onboarding](https://litter.catbox.moe/jjk80w.png)

### After (feature branch) — Onboarding screen using `OpenClawMascot(scale: .emptyState)`

![After - feature branch onboarding](https://litter.catbox.moe/rluebl.png)

The mascot renders identically — which is the expected behavior (visual parity with better infrastructure). Both screenshots are from a fresh simulator install on iPhone 17 Pro (iOS 26.3), built with `xcodebuild` from the respective branch (`upstream/main` vs `feat/ios-iconography-v2`).

## Evidence

### CI results (all iOS checks green)
- `ios-build` ✅ — compiles successfully
- `macos-swift` ✅ — Swift compilation passes
- `Scan iOS dead code` ✅ — no Periphery violations
- `native-i18n` ✅ — inventory synced
- `Real behavior proof` ✅

### Unrelated failure
- `checks-node-compact-small-whole-2` fails on `session-accessor.reply-init-concurrency.test.ts` — pre-existing flaky Node test, not iOS-related.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: Replace ad-hoc `OpenClawProMark` image rendering with standardized `OpenClawMascot` component using predefined scale tiers and proper 3-scale asset catalog
- Real environment tested: macOS 15.5, Xcode 26.3 beta, iPhone 17 Pro Simulator (iOS 26.3.1), Node 24
- Exact steps or command run after this patch: `pnpm ios:gen && xcodebuild build -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath /tmp/openclaw-dd CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO` (with WatchApp dependency removed from project.yml to work around pre-existing WatchApp asset catalog error)
- Evidence after fix (screenshot, recording, terminal capture, console output, redacted runtime log, linked artifact, or copied live output): See "Visual Proof" section above — fresh simulator screenshots from both `upstream/main` and the feature branch showing identical mascot rendering on the Onboarding screen.
- Observed result after fix: The mascot renders at the correct scale tier sizes with accent-colored shadow, matching the prior `OpenClawProMark` visual output but using the new asset catalog entry and standardized `OpenClawMascotScale` enum.
- What was not tested: WatchApp build (pre-existing asset catalog failure on `upstream/main` for WatchApp AppIcon — unrelated to this PR). iPad-specific layout not verified on simulator.
- Proof limitations or environment constraints: Simulator install required temporary removal of `OpenClawWatchApp` dependency from `project.yml` due to pre-existing WatchApp `AppIcon` asset error (`AppIcon did not have any applicable content`) that exists on `upstream/main`. CI `ios-build` successfully builds on Linux runners where this issue does not manifest.

— [Joel Nishanth](https://offlyn.ai) · [offlyn.AI](https://offlyn.ai)
